comment: Engineering-tool imports of the synthetic GSDML fixtures. Each entry is one import by one tool version on one date: outcome imported, imported-with-warnings, rejected or not-run, with the tool's messages verbatim. Entries are added by hand after a manual run (docs/research/GSDML-TOOLS.md); none is inferred.
